plantvillage._note: Train/val/test come from data_meta/plantvillage/resolved_splits/color_{train,val,test}.csv, built once from the HuggingFace mohanty/PlantVillage leaf-grouped official split (see assets/docs/02_taxonomy_mapping.md). Test is the official HF test file, untouched. Val is 10% of the official train, carved by whole leaf-group so no leaf's photos cross train/val.

plantdoc._note: Official train/ and test/ folders from the dataset are used as-is; test is locked. Val is carved from the official train folder at pipeline run-time (no upstream leaf-grouping metadata exists for PlantDoc, so exact-file-hash de-duplication is used as the leakage guard instead).

_numbers_note: This file holds every data-stage knob. Every count/measurement this pipeline produces at run time (per-class/per-split image counts, resolved image sizes, computed channel mean/std, corrupt files found, exact paths resolved) is written to data_manifests/dataset_stats.json and data_manifests/data_config_resolved.json by scripts/run_data_pipeline.py -- nothing is hand-typed or guessed there.
